kind: Node domain-model checks; browser DOM mocked

checks.test: Inbox derives records and builds its complete list/detail views
Repeated monitoring deduplicates stable events and retains read receipts
Recipients have isolated personal history on shared events
Scope filters both notification text and direct detail access
Invalid stored scope does not widen to bank-wide notifications
Snoozes use time and resume without modifying the source
Future optional preferences do not suppress critical events or existing history
Source references are exact; mismatched route IDs are rejected
Acknowledgement is distinct from resolution; completion is source-owned
Program activity creates a notification linked to the actual program
Notification titles, bodies and thread content are escaped in HTML
Integrated source modules build board, governance and KRI views without conflicts
Lowercase priorities retain their meaning across KRI and board events
Actual KRI submission emits a revision-bound approval and review resolves it
Accepted KRI exception remains open until its own remediation task is completed
Changes-requested KRI notification resolves when a correction is resubmitted
Board-style work notification links to the actual task and its completion
